title: The Strange Nectar at the Camp

collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen finds a gourd of sweet-smelling nectar that glows faintly in the shade.

description_variants.description: An Isolan finds a gourd of sweet-smelling nectar that glows faintly in the shade.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) finds a gourd of sweet-smelling nectar hidden in the roots of a tree. It glows, very faintly, in the shade.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) drinks it. (He/she) feels lighter, quicker, younger. When (he/she) looks into the stream, (he/she) is.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) carries it back to the camp. Everyone sniffs it, nobody drinks it, and it ends up on a shelf in (name1)'s hut, glowing quietly to itself, as a curiosity. The Heathens' village gains tech points. \(no effect\)

text_only.reason: the owner's flavor rule (2026-11-23): only Heathens are in this event, so the Heathens' village's tech points is story text only -- the game is not changed, and the draft's line ends "(no effect)"
